notes.title: Enhanced Edition Gameplay Trailer
notes.content:
[img]https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/916919938365203049/5C15BA3253252479CCAA6A774BE907E5193DA4C8/[/img]

[b]Space Hulk: Deathwing - Enhanced Edition arrives on May 22, 2018![/b]

Dive into today’s brand new Gameplay Trailer to celebrate the upcoming release, will be available free for all current owners on PC.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qhD62Nzat1c
Play as a Space Marine of the Deathwing – the feared 1st Company of the secretive Dark Angels – and engage in a desperate battle against Genestealers within the confines of a Space Hulk. Grow more powerful, gain skills and abilities, and master devastating weapons as you earn experience. 

Play solo or online cooperative multiplayer with up to four players. The Enhanced Edition brings a host of new content and upgrades, expanding upon the base game for the ultimate Space Hulk experience:
[list][*]Class Customization – deep progression system lets players unlock armour and weapon skins, attachments, perks and more for aesthetic and gameplay customization.
[*]Chaplain Class – the Chaplain brings a host of abilities to increase the squad’s survivability, and is more than capable of killing hordes of Xenos in melee combat.
[*]New Weapons – more melee and ranged weapons give players even more options to load out their squad for battle.
[*]New Enemy Types – new, unique Genestealer types offer a greater challenge to those who dare enter the depths of the Space Hulk.
[*]Special Missions – Randomized objectives and enemy spawns bring a new level of replayability.[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26231890/5bc8d6a0f9bea79324e0f610ce619937626cc9e3.jpg[/img]

All aspects of the Class Customization are earned entirely in-game, with no microtransactions. Several of the above features have already been made freely available on PC, as part of the game’s ongoing support.

[b]Space Hulk: Deathwing - Enhanced Edition arrives on May 22, with all Enhanced Edition content free for owners of the game on PC.[/b]

notes.title: Update 7: The Interrogator-Chaplain
notes.content:
[img]https://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2017/29/4/1500562374-spacehulk-screens03.jpg[/img]

[h1]Greetings Brothers,[/h1] 

The seventh update is now live for Space Hulk: Deathwing!

This new update is part of our development of the major content addition coming later this year with the release of Space Hulk: Deathwing on consoles - free on PC.

[b]Today, we introduce the Interrogator-Chaplain Class to Space Hulk: Deathwing, the sixth class![/b]

[img]https://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2017/29/4/1500562963-spacehulk-screens02.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Key Features:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]New Class Integration: The Interrogator Chaplain 
The Chaplain can carry the Crozius Arcanum and brings new diversity to the Multiplayer and Special Missions Game Modes. 
He has the unique ability to recall all allies, or protect them for a short time. 
[*]New Weapons (Stormbolter MK2, Purgatory Sword).
[*]Psygate System has been overhauled: you can now only open a portal to the psygate when you successfully achieve an objective. Works in both solo and multiplayer. You can no longer open psygate at will except during the solo campaign. 
[*]Changes to Solo Special Missions: you now play as a specialised class in Special Missions - each class now has its own niche, instead of being a jack of all trades. This was made to make the mode more similar to multiplayer and in preparation for the customisation system.
[*]UI Improvements and rework
[*]Font rework 
[*]Improved menu controller support 
[*]Controller improvements – XB1 or XB360 controller advised 
[/list]
[h1][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Multiple UI bugfixes and improvements
[*]Multiple Controller bugfixes in the menu: all menus and gameplay should now be playable with a controller 
[*]Added a confirmation check when using the “leave” button on a multiplayer lobby
[*]Added a restart button after dying on a Solo Special Mission
[*]Fixed a few cases of overlapping GUI elements when opening different menus
[*]Fixed a rare out of bounds in Chapter 3. 
[*]Fixed the Librarian arm’s being slighty invisible when equipped with a powerfist.
[*]Fixed the name of the Special Missions being displayed with a “beta” tag
[*]Fixed some AI pathfinding issues in Chapter 2.
[*]Fixed some issues remaining in a few Special Missions. 
[*]Fixed the Broodlord spawn in Chapter 7.
[*]Fixed the cages in Chapter 6 not having proper collision detection.
[*]Fixed in Chapter 4, Genestealers could spawn on a height and get stuck
[*]Fixed in Chapter 5, Hybrids could spawn behind a rock and get stuck
[*]Fixed turrets firing through walls in Chapter 2
[*]Fixed major FPS drops at the end of Chapter 9
[*]Fixed some issues when switching classes too fast in a lobby
[*]Fixed some lights in the tutorial 
[*]Fixed some flickering textures
[*]Fixed some levitating environmental assets
[/list]
[h1][b]Known Issues[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]The new psygate system has a few issues still 
[*]Guest users will sometimes not see the GUI of the spells Frenzy, Firestorm, Crusaders, and chaplain spells. 
[*]Guest using the heavy specialty class can sometimes have issues using the proximity mine when coming from a lobby.
[*]The orders wheel may sometimes not be called in multiplayer (keyboard shortcuts are still usable).
[*]In solo modes, teammates may sometimes not respond to your orders.
[*]On very rare occasions, a solo Special Mission may not end.
[*]You may encounter partially unloaded maps for a few seconds when jumping in a multiplayer game.
[*]The lobby menu may overlap on your game if you join a game at the exact moment the host launches it.
[*]When an objective is completed in multiplayer, it might stop the current action of a guest player.

[img]https://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2017/29/4/1500567173-spacehulk-screens01.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Beta Branch Update - Patch 7
notes.content:
[img]https://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2017/28/4/1499956383-spacehulk-deathwing-22.jpg[/img]

Greetings Brothers,

We're pleased to update the Beta testing branch!

This new update is part of our development of the major content addition coming later this year with the release of Space Hulk: Deathwing on consoles - free on PC.

Today, we introduce the Interrogator Chaplain Class to Space Hulk: Deathwing, the sixth class!

For more details on the Enhanced Edition, please see the previous update post [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/298900/announcements/detail/1299696599442548376]here[/url].

[b]We plan to deploy this new update in the near future and have updated the Beta branch to make sure we release the patch in the best possible state.[/b] As always, your feedback about its content are more than welcome. Please focus your feedback on new content (Interrogator Chaplain class).

[h1][b]Key Features:[/b][/h1] 
[list]
[*] New Class Integration : The Interrogator Chaplain.
[*]New Weaponry (Stormbolter MK2, Purgatory Sword).
[*]Psygate System overhaul: you now open a portal to the psygate when you successfully achieve an objective. Works in both solo and multiplayer. You can no longer open psygate at will except during the solo campaign. 
[*]Changes to Solo Special Missions: you now play as a specialised class in Special Missions - each class now has its own niche, instead of being a jack of all trades. This was made to make the mode more similar to multiplayer and in preparation for the customisation system.
[*]UI Improvements
[*]Improved menu controller support.  
[*] Controller improvements
[/list]

[h1][b]How you can help us out![/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Feel free to give feedback on the new content.
[*]Please let us know about any technical issues you are having. 
[*]Feedback on the UI
[*]We are having positive results with XB1 controllers, but we do appear to be having issues with PS4 controllers. We would greatly appreciate feedback based on PS4 controllers being used in Big Picture mode. 

[/list]

[h1][b]Known Issues of the build:[/b][/h1] 
[list]
[*]Entering a lobby without codex rules, then going into solo special missions limits the number of weapons you can access.
[*] Server maps are not displayed.
[*]Your equipment is not reset when going from one SM to another, or when going to a new multiplayer game
[*]Obsolete servers will take some extra time to disappear from the list
[*]In solo SM, the score screen displays wrong information
[*]There’s a crash if you afk in the main menu
[*]The new psygate system has a few issues still 
[*]When playing in “normal” multiplayer (without codex rules on), you can access more weapons than intended
[*]Guest cannot change weaponry in the lobby
[*]The second lobby created by the same host cannot be joined
[*]When you join a lobby, you will be first sent to the main menu
[*]Guest users will sometimes not see the GUI of the spells Frenzy, Firestorm, Crusaders, and chaplain spells. 
[*]Guest using the heavy speciality class can sometimes have issue using the proximity mine
[*]Orders wheel has been disabled in solo mode for rework.
[/list]

[h1][b]How to access the patch 7 open beta[/b][/h1]
From your Steam library, right-click on ‘Space Hulk: Deathwing’ then go to Properties > Betas
Select the beta “nextpatch” 
Launch the game to start the update

[h1][b]How to report issues and bugs[/b][/h1]

Please report any issues encountered in the [u]Technical Section of the Steam Hub[/u] with the flag [BETA] in the title.

Before posting your feedback, please read the known issues list carefully.

In order to help us to locate and fix bugs, please include the dump files and DxDiag in your report. Try to give us as much details as possible about the issue and what you were doing when it happened. Screenshots are also welcome.
[list]
[*]Dump files - first, you must enable the visibility of “Hidden Folders” in your Windows settings. You can find how to do it on Google. Then, go to "C:\Users\CURRENTUSER\AppData\Local\SpaceHulkGame\Saved\Logs" (replace "currentuser" by your User Name on your computer). If you crashed, the game automatically creates a folder that you can compress into a .zip (or .rar) file and attach in your post.
[*]DxDiag - Press the WINDOWS key (bottom left), then type DXDIAG in the Search Bar and click on the corresponding program. A diagnosis will be executed then. After it's done, click on "Save all information" and save the DxDiag as text file (.txt).
After this, all you need to do is to compress them into a zip file (with the Dump files) and attach it to your post here with a detailed description of your crash.
[/list]

[b]The Emperor calls once again for your assistance - to battle!

The Deathwing Team[/b]

notes.title: Update 6: Return To Olethros
notes.content:
[img=https://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2017/24/2/1497361453-shd-genestealers-gif-2.gif][/img]

Greetings Brothers, 

[b]The sixth update is now live for Space Hulk: Deathwing!

This update adds exciting new content and features for players who dare enter the Genestealer-infested Space Hulk – all of which will be included in a series of free content updates for PC players.[/b] 

[img=https://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2017/24/2/1497360876-spacehulk-deathwing-12.jpg][/img]

Today's patch focuses on additional gameplay variety, as well as fully introducing the Special Missions mode to singleplayer and multiplayer. 

Special Missions bring a new level of uncertainty for even the most hardened Terminator squads. Starting a chapter will generate a randomised sequence of missions and Genestealer spawns for a truly unpredictable challenge. 

Here are today's patch notes:

[h1][b]Additions:[/b][/h1]
 
[b]Full Special Missions feature released in both single and multiplayer[/b]
[list]
[*]All 7 chapters playable.
[*]All the content can be accessed in single-player (from the main menu) and multiplayer (through a lobby).
[*]You unlock the special missions in singleplayer after completing the chapter in the solo campaign. For example if your most advanced save is in chapter 7, you will have access to single-player special missions from Chapter 1 to 6.
[*]If you no longer have your save file or haven’t finished the campaign, but would like to try the new game modes in singleplayer, you'll find [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=http://cdn.focus-home.com/admin/games/space_hulk:_deathwing/file/PersistentUserSave.sav]HERE[/url] a file unlocking all special missions. Put the file in C:\Users\USERNAME\AppData\Local\SpaceHulkGame\Saved\SaveGames
[/list]
[h1][b]New Multiplayer Skills[/b][/h1]
[list][b]Proximity Mine[b]
[*]Places an explosive proximity mine.
[*]Heavy Weapon Skill
[/list]
[list][b]Skull Drone[/b]
[*]Summons a combat drone to temporarily fight at your side.
[*]Tactic Skill
[/list]
[list][b]Frenzy[/b]
[*]Briefly increases your melee attack speed.
[*]Assault Skill
[/list]
[list][b]Fire Storm[/b]
[*]Briefly increases your weapon's rate of fire.
[*]Heavy Weapon Skill
[/list]
[h1][b]Gameplay Tweaks[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]The limitation on classes in multiplayer has now been removed.
[*]Shortcuts for orders have been enabled in multiplayer. 
[*]It is now possible to go back to main menu during the score screen of a multiplayer game.
[*]Holding shift when out of endurance no longer drains your endurance.
[/list] 
[h1][b]Bugfixes:[/b][/h1]
 [list]
[*]Multiple AI navigation fixes
[*]Multiple localization fixes
[*]Fixed some issues with collisions
[*]Fixed a rare issue with LoD
[*]When joining an already in-progress multiplayer game, you should no longer see the partially loaded chapter for a few seconds (it can still happen on some low end hardware).
[*]Broodlords should no longer have a pathfinding issue causing them to fly to their destination.
[*]Fixed Belial saying a random line at the end of a Special Mission
[*]Fixed a bug where the first dialogue of a chapter would play when opening the armory in the bridgehead
[*]The language of the logs and objectives during a multiplayer game is now based on your own settings rather than those of the host.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused the logs to not be properly displayed in multiplayer.
[*]Motion blur is now working properly for all hardware.
[*]Fixed many issues when joining a game where all the others players were dead. This includes graphical glitches resolutions, overlapping menus and a possible block.
[*]Fixed an issue where a widget would appear repeatedly.
[*]Fixed a block at the end of chapter 6 where a player was teleported inside the last room at the end of a multiplayer game.
[*]A few rare random crashes have been resolved.
[*]Fixed GUI issues during certain objectives when joining a multiplayer game.
[*]Fixed a possible overlap with the armory HUD in a multiplayer game or when spectating through the death camera.
[*]Fixed a couple of minor issues in Chapter 1 Special Missions.
[/list] 
 
[h1][b]Known Issues:[/b][/h1]
 [list]
[*]Rare DirectX crash
[*]If you try to join a full server, you will be connected to a different one with an available spot instead.
[*]It is possible for the inventory menu in multiplayer to overlap with the game and create an unplayable state.
[*]It is possible that guests cannot open their inventory menu in multiplayer game.
[*]When an objective is finished in multiplayer, it might stop the current action of a guest player.
[*]Relics are not currently acknowledged on the score screen for guests in multiplayer game.
[*]In multiplayer, if a Librarian equips a powerfist, you will see a small gap in his arm

notes.title: Update 5 & Enhanced Edition
notes.content:
[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/49/1481024355-shd-weapon-gif-2.gif[/img]

Greetings Brothers, 

The fifth update is now live for Space Hulk: Deathwing!

[b]This new update kicks off the countdown to Space Hulk: Deathwing's Enhanced Edition for PS4 and Xbox One in Q4 2017.

This edition will add exciting new content and features for players who dare enter the Genestealer-infested Space Hulk – all of which will be included in a series of free content updates for PC players. [/b]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/cqSY4Ie.jpg[/img]

This latest patch focuses on more gameplay variety by introducing the Special Missions game mode to multiplayer. 

Special Missions, which have been added to Chapter 1 but are coming later to every chapter in the game, bring a new level of uncertainty for even the most hardened Terminator squads. Starting a chapter will generate a randomized sequence of missions and Genestealer spawns for a truly unpredictable challenge. 

[b]We are also excited to share a glimpse of just a few of the upcoming features players can look forward to in the Enhanced Edition: 
[list][*]Full multiplayer progression system with loot and class customization 
[*]New multiplayer class 
[*]New weapon and skills 
[*]New enemies[/list][/b]
[img]https://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2017/10/1489055661-spacehulk-deathwing-14.jpg[/img]

[b]Here is today's patch notes:[/b]

[h1][b]New[/b][/h1]
[list][*][b]Special Missions arrives in chapter 1 in multiplayer![/b]
[list][*]Played in the existing maps, players must successfully achieve different objectives randomly chosen.[/list]
[*]Genestealer variations have been added - more scale and shading diversity![/list]

[h1][b]Gameplay[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Apothecary cooldowns in multiplayer are longer if you do not have the Narthecium.
[*]Narthecium heal cooldown set to 60s. 
[*]When playing a “hold the position” objective, you have to stay in the siege area (automatic defeat outside the area after some time).[/list]

[h1][b]Bugfix[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Fix of a possible block when opening the inventory as a guest player. 
[*]Fix some rare cases of bad behaviour or pathfinding (stuck Genestealer).
[*]Fix of a rare case when you could be stuck in an empty lobby.
[*]Multiple graphical glitches fixes.
[*]Multiple controller menu fixes.
[*]Multiple GUI and menu fixes.
[*]Fix of a potential blocking issue with saves created during the first objective of chapter 7.
[*]Fix of a potential block occurring when loading a save at the end of chapter 4.
[*]Fix of issues related to dialogues being played when loading a save.
[*]Fix of an issue occurring during a dialogue with the slomo option.
[*]Fix of an issue where the player was losing SFX when loading a save during a dialogue with the slomo option.
[*]Fix of an issue when saving with a jammed weapon.
[*]Fix of a potential blocking issue occurring when issuing many inputs on the inventory menu with a controller.
[*]Performance improvement in the psygate.
[*]Fix of a potential blocking issue when loading a save inside the torpedoes in the chapter 1.
[*]Fix of a SFX issue after locking a door.
[*]Fix of a bug allowing players to unlock doors without being near them.[/list]

[h1][b]Known Issues[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Crash DirectX is still being worked on.
[*]When joining an already started multiplayer game, you can see the partially unloaded chapter during 2/3sec.
[*]If joining at the very moment host launch the game, you enter the chapter with lobby menu overlapping the game. (Multiplayer only)
[*]If you try to join a full server, you will be connected to a different one with an available spot instead.
[*]Some attacks on the hold position of the C.A.T in the chapter 8 will not launch properly.
[*]When an objective is finished in multiplayer, it might stop the current action of a guest player.
[*]Zoom sensitivity has been changed from the previous build, let us know what you think about it![/list]

notes.title: Update 4 Release
notes.content:
[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/49/1481024355-shd-weapon-gif-2.gif[/img]
Greetings Librarians,

[b]We're pleased to release the update 4 for Space Hulk: Deathwing.[/b]

This patch brings a host of fixes and improvements – we’d like to extend a huge thanks to all players that have played the beta and given us feedback. Your help has been extremely useful in the continued improvement of our game.

Our first priority after the release was to fix the most urgent technical issues. That's why the main changes of this patch are technical fixes - we updated the graphical engine and rebuilt all the levels. 

[b]Here is a short list of features and improvements of the update:[/b]
[list][*]More weapons in Multiplayer – this includes the addition of the Heavy Flamer and Hellfire.
[*]Expanded class loadouts in Multiplayer – each class has more choice of what to bring into battle!
[*]Improved multiplayer load times – simultaneous loading time for all players.
[*]Performance improvements.
[*]Loading time improvements.
[*]General stability improvements.
[*]Multiplayer experience improvements.
[*]Improved Anti-Aliasing options.
[*]Hardware-related issues Fixes (on AMD GC).[/list]
[b]That's only the first step and there are still many more exciting things to come, as we’ll be supporting our game with free content updates throughout the year.[/b] 

We'll now focus on improving gameplay and content based on your feedback since launch - replay value and multiplayer long term progression are our main priorities.

[img]https://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2017/10/1489055661-spacehulk-deathwing-14.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Space Hulk: Deathwing - Update 1.29d[/b][/h1]

[b]New Features[/b]
[list][*]All the multiplayer classes (except the assault) got extended weaponry available.
[*]Added new weapons in multiplayer (Heavy Flamer and HellFire).
[*]PAD menu is now available.
[*]Genestealers Psykers are now able to teleport.
[*]Genestealer Warrior-strain will now have a chance to release a thorax swarm on death.[/list]
[b]Improvements[/b]
[list][*]Overall Performance Improvement LD / IA / Gameplay / Streaming.
[*]When loading a multiplayer map, all players now load at the same time. 
[*]Improved loading times for all maps.
[*]Added more accurate deconnection popup in case of issue in a multiplayer game.
[*]Improved Anti-aliasing options.
[*]Improved Genestealer Behavior.
[*]Axis Inversion now works properly in the wheel order.[/list]
[b]GUI[/b]
[list][*]You no longer see your class icon on top of the screen in solo play.
[*]When entering a new ship, the description of the ship can no longer be seen while in tactical map. 
[*]In multiplayer, when playing the chapter 5 to 9, the XP bonus for guests players is no longer seen for the host.

notes.title: Update 4 Beta
notes.content:
[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/47/1480073741-shd-enterthespacehulk-1.gif[/img]

Greetings Librarians,

[b]The fourth update beta is now live for Space Hulk: Deathwing![/b]

Our two main goals with this major patch were to [b]update the version of Unreal Engine 4[/b] used by Space Hulk: Deathwing and add [b]simultaneous loading[/b] in multiplayer.

Updating the graphical engine required all the maps to be updated and the lights rebuilt, which took longer than we expected. Simultaneous loading will vastly improve the loading times and synchronized spawns in multiplayer.

Here is the list of features and improvements of the update, based on your feedback since release. They’re primarily for the multiplayer portion of our game:
[list][*][b]More weapons in Multiplayer[/b]– this includes the addition of the Heavy Flamer and Hellfire.
[*][b]Expanded class loadouts in Multiplayer[/b]– each class has more choice of what to bring into battle!
[*]Improved multiplayer load times – simultaneous loading time for all players.
[*]Performance improvements 
[*]General stability improvements
[*]Multiplayer experience improvements
[*]Improved Anti-Aliasing options
[*]Genestealer tweaks[/list]
This major update affects a wide part of the game. [b]Keep in mind that the build of Space Hulk: Deathwing that you’ll have access to is still in development and not in a finalized state[/b]. You will likely encounter bugs, graphics issues, network problems and more. Because of this, [b]we would really appreciate your feedback regarding[/b]:
[list][*][b]Performance[/b] (freezes, important lags, big FPS drops…)
[*][b]Stability[/b] (crashes) 
[*][b]Connectivity[/b] (disconnections, issues joining a game…)
[*][b]Multiplayer[/b] gaming experience[/list]
[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/36/1473240675-spacehulk-deathwing-17.jpg[/img]

Our tech-priests have written up the following guide for how to gain access to this beta, as well as how you can help us ensure it’s up to scratch on full release:

[h1][b]How to access the patch 4 open beta[/b][/h1]
[list][*]From your Steam library, right-click on ‘Space Hulk: Deathwing’ then go to Properties > Betas
[*]Select the beta “nextpatch” 
[*]Launch the game to start the update
[*]The update is approximately 10Gb, but after the download it should take less hard drive space than before. However, please ensure you have at least 10Gb available on your disk while downloading. [/list]
[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/36/1473240675-spacehulk-deathwing-16.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]How to report issues and bugs[/b][/h1]

Please report any issues encountered in the --> [url=http://forum.spacehulk-deathwing.com/viewforum.php?f=26]dedicated section on the official Space Hulk: Deathwing support forum[/url]. <--

Before posting your feedback, please read the known issues list carefully and be sure to report it in the correct category - it really helps us to read it and process everything!

In order to help us to locate and fix bugs, please include the dump files and DxDiag in your report. Try to give us as much details as possible about the issue and what you were doing when it happened. Screenshots are also welcome.
[list][*][b]Dump files[/b] - first, you must enable the visibility of “Hidden Folders” in your Windows settings. You can find how to do it on Google. Then, go to "C:\Users\CURRENTUSER\AppData\Local\SpaceHulkGame\Saved\Logs" (replace "currentuser" by your User Name on your computer). If you crashed, the game automatically creates a folder that you can compress into a .zip (or .rar) file and attach in your post.
[*][b]DxDiag[/b] - Press the WINDOWS key (bottom left), then type DXDIAG in the Search Bar and click on the corresponding program. A diagnosis will be executed then. After it's done, click on "Save all information" and save the DxDiag as text file (.txt).[/list]
After this, all you need to do is to compress them into a zip file (with the Dump files) and attach it to your post here with a detailed description of your crash.

Once again, we would really much appreciate your feedback regarding:
[list][*][b]Performance[/b] (freezes, important lags, big FPS drops…)
[*][b]Stability[/b] (crashes) 
[*][b]Connectivity[/b] (disconnections, issues joining a game…)
[*][b]Multiplayer[/b] gaming experience[/list]
[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/36/1473240675-spacehulk-deathwing-13.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Known issues[/b][/h1]

[b]Blocks[/b]
[list][*]Chapter 6 cannot be completed in multiplayer mode if a guest jumps in or is disconnected 
[i]Workaround: entering guest must exit and re-enter the room[/i]
[*]Chapter 5 in solo mode: objective “Kill 200 enemies” may be randomly impossible to complete due to a spawner bug
[i]Workaround: exit the game and load your save[/i]
[*]Rebinding the Esc key gets you stuck in game without access to the Esc menu
[i]No workaround: Do not rebind the Esc key[/i] [/list]
[b]Crashes[/b]
[list][*]Extensive inactivity in multiplayer mode can cause the game to crash among co-players (more than 1 hour of inactivity)[/list]
[b]Other[/b]
[list][*]English is the only available language
[*]Kills performed with the Heavy Flamer are not counted in the scoreboard
[*]GUI (minimap) displaying issues in multiplayer (jump-in, chapter 1, changing maps)
[*]Maps might appear incompletely loaded on lower setups
[*]Loading screen issues: 
[list][*]Displayed loading screen might be inconsistent
[*]Game runs in the background while the validation screen (Press X to start mission) is displayed[/list]
[*]No keyboard type detection
[*]Vocal chat in multiplayer is automatically on
[*]Zooming might cause big framerate drops
[*]Bugs occur when loading Chapter 1 in multiplayer mode (briefing and armoury steps are missing)
[*]Bugs occur when loading a save in solo mode (NPC are missing, played dialogs are incorrect…)
[*]Bugs occur for the host when spamming the Cancel/Ready button in the lobby as a guest when the countdown is over[/list]

notes.content:

Greetings Brothers!

We're pleased to release our first update for Space Hulk: Deathwing.

The main goal of this first patch was to eliminate any game breaking bugs, crashes and severe FPS drops. We hope many of you are now better able to enjoy the game! That said, we’re aware that some players are experiencing occasional lobby connection errors and performance issues, and that’s our current focus as we continue to read your messages on social media.

You can report your issues in the technical section of the [url=http://forum.spacehulk-deathwing.com/viewforum.php?f=13]official forum[/url]. [b]Space Hulk: Deathwing - Hotfix 1.06 - 231MB[/b]

[*]Major FPS drop on Chapter 1 experienced by AMD processors fixed.

notes.content:
[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/50/1481710022-shd-gif-3.gif[/img]

Greetings Brothers,

[b]Space Hulk: Deathwing is now available![/b]

We're pleased to release Space Hulk: Deathwing after 4 years of development, and we'd like to thank you once again for your help during the beta phases. Your feedback has been incredibly useful for exterminating a wide range of Heretical bugs, and to implement improvements!

Here are some of the highlights with regards to bug-fixes and improvements in the release version: 
[list][*][b]Much faster loading times[/b]
[list][*]Loading times are reduced by rougly 40-50% on average.[/list][/list]
[list][*][b]•	Huge performance increase[/b]
[list][*]The game should run more smoothly in most situations across all hardware.[/list][/list]
[list][*][b]Crash Fixes & Massive debug[/b] 
[list][*]The vast majority of crashes and bugs from the Beta have been fixed.[/list][/list]
[list][*][b]GUI improvements[/b] 
[list][*]The GUI has been updated according to Beta players' feedback.[/list][/list]
[list][*][b]Balancing[/b] 
[list][*]Changes regarding some multiplayer classes and difficulty values.[/list][/list]
[list][*][b]Localization improvements & debugging[/b] 
[list][*]Localization is almost final. Added some indications on the tutorial keybinds.[/list][/list]
[list][*][b]SFX Iteration[/b] 
[list][*]Belial and Librarian voices have been updated according to Beta players' feedback.[/list][/list]
[list][*][b]Controller debugging[/b] 
[list][*][b]Controllers aren't officially supported at release.[/b] Controllers previously corrupted keybindings. This is no longer the case, and the controller mapping has been updated. We're not 100% satisfied yet with controller support, and we strongly advise you to play with keyboard and mouse for now.[/list][/list]
[list][*][b]New Optional Multiplayer Game Mode: Codex Rules[/b]
[list][*]Class change during mission disabled.
[*]Equipment changing during mission disabled. 
[*]Progression and XP system deactivated, with access to all equipment unlocked from the start.

Our main priority was to have a smooth release with no game breaking bugs preventing you from purging the Space Hulk. As with every game launch, certain bugs may still remain. [b]Please read our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/298900/discussions/1/152391920351853567/]technical FAQ[/url] and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/298900/discussions/0/152391920351911360/]Gameplay Tips[/url][/b].

[b]We’ll continue to listen to our community as we support the game into the future! Keep talking to us, Brothers, we’re listening![/b]

Have fun purging the Xenos tide!

The Emperor Protects! 
[b]Streum On Studio & Focus Home Interactive[/b]

notes.title: Beta Survival Guide
notes.content:
[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/47/1480073741-shd-enterthespacehulk-1.gif[/img]

Greetings Librarians,

[b]The last hours have seen countless waves of reckless Terminators purge Genestealers in the Space Hulk Olethros![/b]

The Emperor is proud to announce that over [b]1 million Genestealers[/b] have already been purified since the Beta launched!

We're delighted to see that so many of you dived into the Beta and posted feedback on the official forum. The main goal of this Beta is to collect player feedback and the amounts of reports we already received is going to be very helpful when ironing out Space Hulk: Deathwing before release. 

We're aware that some of you are experiencing major technical issues - we are working around the clock to fix them. The vast majority of the issues you are encountering are known and listed in our [url=http://forum.spacehulk-deathwing.com/viewtopic.php?f=17&t=2635]Known Issues post[/url].

[b]As a reminder, the version of Space Hulk: Deathwing that you have access to is still in development, and not in a finalized state.[/b]

Here is a short guide to help you slash your way through the horde of Genestealers!

[h1]Server Lobby[/h1]

[list][*]When opening the server browser, there will be a delay before all servers are displayed. Please be patient, they'll appear after a short delay!
[*]The server lobby display isn't finalised right now. Use the "Quickmatch" button to find a game automatically.
[*]When you hit the "Join" button, you currently don't get any visual feedback, but the button works - you may just have to wait a little while.
[*]You can also join the game of a friend directly through Steam. Friend List > Right click on your friend > Join Game.[/list]

[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/47/1480069580-serverbrowser.png[/img]

[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/47/1480069818-spacehulkgame-win64-shipping-2016-11-25-11-29-28-92.png[/img]

[h1]Game Lobby[/h1]

[list][*]You can invite your Steam friends by clicking on the "+".[/list]
[list][*]You may have noticed on the right-hand side of the lobby screen, a UI element in which you can only select Chapter 2 (as this is the only chapter available in the beta). This currently doesn't really have much of a functional use, but in the full game the host will be able to build a playlist of multiple chapters to play through in one session.[/list]

[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/47/1480069581-lobbyempty.png[/img]

[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/47/1480069580-spacehulkgame-win64-shipping-2016-11-25-11-19-56-59.png[/img]

[list][*]When building your squad, we'd recommend carefully considering your team's composition of classes. In particular, you'll probably have a very hard time without an Apothecary (who can heal up your squad). [b]If you want to survive the Space Hulk, bring an Apothecary[/b]![/list]

[h1]In-Game[/h1]

[list][*]Press (i) to change your class and/or weapon (if you unlocked new weapons).[/list]

[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/47/1480069580-loadout.png[/img]

[list][*]Press (y) to chat with your squad.[/list]

[list][*]When your whole squad dies, the screen displayed is a Placeholder. In the final release, it will be where players vote for the next map, but the Beta only features 1 map, hence the issue. If you wait 1 minute, the host will automatically reload the map and then the guests will reload too.[/list]

[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/47/1480069581-spacehulkgame-win64-shipping-2016-11-25-11-23-39-17.png[/img]

notes.title: For The Lion!
notes.content:
[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/46/1479396432-shd-gif-1.gif[/img]

Greetings Librarians!

The release of Space Hulk: Deathwing draws near, arriving December 9th on PC. To help prepare for the battles that await you, we’re publishing a series of Devblogs to tell you about some of the features and gameplay elements you can look forward to when you venture deep into the Space Hulk and face the Genestealer menace.

[h1]Solo Campaign[/h1]

Space Hulk: Deathwing features a full solo campaign, with a twisting narrative co-written by renowned Black Library author Gav Thorpe. 

During your journey into the Space Hulk Olethros, you’ll be accompanied by two AI-controlled Terminator squad mates. Brother Barachiel is your Heavy Support, unleashing destruction in battle with weapons such as the Assault Cannon and Plasma Cannon. Brother Nahum is your Apothecary, healing up your squad whenever possible.

[img]https://scontent-cdg2-1.xx.fbcdn.net/t31.0-8/15068980_1123345267741339_2854812183630441147_o.jpg[/img]

You can issue commands to your AI squad mates using a radial menu that can be brought up at any time. Beyond having them follow you on your position, you can also tell them to move to a specific point, guard an area, seal doors, ask Nahum to heal a squad member, and more. 

There are four difficulty modes to choose from in Space Hulk: Deathwing’s solo campaign:
[list][*][b]Disciple[/b] (Easy) – The Emperor protects you from the Xenos.
[*][b]Chapter Champion[/b] (Normal) – You’re used to life on the battlefield.
[*][b]Lion’s Sword[/b] (Hard) – What doesn’t kill us makes us stronger.
[*][b]No Mercy[/b] (Hardest) – To die for the emperor is glorious! [/list]
During the solo campaign, you’ll be playing as a Librarian of the Dark Angels’ Deathwing chapter. This means you have access to a range of Psychic abilities to use in battle, which includes the following: 
[list][*][b]Shockwave[/b] - Releases a flow of energy around the Librarian, pushing back and hurting the enemies in a 360-degree arc.
[*][b]Chain Lightning[/b] - Lightning strikes the first enemy it hits. Turrets and sentries are particularly susceptible to this power.
[*][b]Inferno[/b] - The Librarian draws his powers to create an image of vengeful flame, carbonising all enemies in a line in front of him.
[*][b]Spontaneous combustion[/b] – Causes an enemy to explode, creating a damaging flame blast around them. 
[*][b]Vortex of doom[/b] - The Librarian tears the veil of reality; victims near the vortex are pulverised by the power of the warp.
[*][b]Lion’s Shadow[/b] - The Librarian teleports himself inside an enemy, before exploding out of them.
[*][b]Lion’s Nemesis[/b] - The Librarian uses his mighty powers to become a fearsome Zealot. Just one hit can slay any normal enemy. [/list]
These abilities are unlocked as you progress through the campaign, giving you more options to deal with the Xenos menace! As your squad ventures deeper into Olethros, you’ll also uncover dark secrets, remarkable environments and greater dangers. Of course, going solo isn’t your only option…

[img]https://scontent-cdg2-1.xx.fbcdn.net/t31.0-8/15129626_1123356014406931_8821086735773448570_o.jpg[/img]

[h1]Purging With Friends[/h1]

All missions and chapters are playable in the online co-operative mode. Up to four of the Emperor’s finest can play together at once, with options for joining from the server list, hosting your own game, or automatically finding a suitable game by selecting ‘QuickMatch’.

The server list contains a number of filters to make it easy to find a suitable game. These include options for LAN only, passwords, languages and more. 

From the game lobby screen, players can select from a range of different options to customize their co-operative experience. Hosts can invite their Steam friends directly to the lobby from here. One of four difficulties must be chosen, as well as the option to turn on Friendly Fire. 

It’s possible to play through the chapters in the same order as the solo campaign, or select a single chapter. The host can also construct their own ‘mini campaign’ by putting together a playlist of selected chapters in any order.

[img]https://scontent-cdg2-1.xx.fbcdn.net/t31.0-8/15025469_1123352291073970_1544488590553095775_o.jpg[/img]

Each player is able to select the class they’d like to play from one of the following:
[list][*][b]Librarian[/b] - The only class with access to Psychic powers, including Shockwave and Chain Lightning and Spontaneous Combustion.
[*][b]Apothecary[/b] – Equipped with his Narthecium, the Apothecary can heal his squad mates and activate a heal aura.
[*][b]Assault Speciality[/b] – Unrivalled in melee combat, this Terminator uses hammers, maces and Lightning Claws to rip apart the Xenos hordes.
[*][b]Heavy Weapon Speciality[/b] - Focuses on tearing enemies apart with highly destructive weapons, including the Assault Cannon and Plasma Cannon.
[*][b]Tactical Speciality[/b] – Allows fallen squad mates to return to battle, and has access to a legendary modified Plasma Cannon – the Spear of Caliban. [/list]
Many combinations of classes are possible, though it’s advised to bring a balanced squad that accommodated for each class’ weaknesses for the best chance at survival!

Stay tuned! We’ll soon release more information regarding the exact starting date of the upcoming beta, and how you can gain access.

Pre-order on Steam now and get access to the pre-order Beta, 15% off, and one in-game weapon – the Lost Mace of Corswain: 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/298900/

All glory to the Emperor!

[b]Streum On Studio and Focus Home Interactive[/b]

notes.title: To Battle, Brothers!
notes.content:
[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/45/1478787664-vlcsnap-2015-02-20-12h27m48s65.png[/img]
Greetings Librarians! 

The release of Space Hulk: Deathwing draws near, arriving December 9th on PC. To help prepare for the battles that await you, we’ve written up this Devblog to tell you about some of the features and gameplay elements you can look forward to when you venture deep into the Space Hulk and face the Genestealer menace. 

[b]The Armoury [/b]

Before entering the fray, you will equip yourself (and your AI squad-mates if playing solo) with the best weapons the Imperium has to offer. With a wealth of melee and ranged weaponry combinations available, you might be outnumbered in battle, but you’ll never be outgunned! 

Weapons you’ll be using to purge Genestealers include: 

[list][*][b]Storm Bolter[/b] – Double-barreled version of the classic bolter. Standard issue for the Terminators, each self-propelled bolt explodes with devastating effect after impacting with its target. 
[*][b]Assault Cannon[/b] – Six-barreled, self-loading, and deadly. This fast-firing weapon can deal incredible damage, but is susceptible to jamming during sustained bursts. 
[*][b]Heavy Flamer[/b] – Short-ranged weapon that spews highly volatile streams of flammable liquid that ignites upon contact with air. Particularly destructive against tightly compacted swarms of Xenos.  
[*][b]Plasma Cannon[/b] – Uses plasma technology to unleash superheated matter on its victims. Blasts from the Plasma Cannon can generate the destructive heat of a small sun – earning them the nickname of ‘Sun Guns’ among some of the Imperial populace. This power comes at a cost – the Plasma Cannon can be prone to overheating. 
[*][b]Lightning Claw[/b] – Each Claw is a powered gauntlet, fitted with four Adamantium blades and surrounded by a matter-disrupting power field. Dual-wielded Lightning Claws are capable of carving through armour and flesh with ease. 
[*][b]Thunder Hammer [/b]– This weapon incorporates an energy field generator within its head, triggered to active whenever the Thunder Hammer strikes its target. Upon contact, an incredible amount of force is released, resulting in a blast of energy and a deafeningly roll of thunder.[/list]

Your Armoury will be expanded even further beyond the weapons listed above, as you venture deeper and deeper into the Space Hulk. Each weapon has specific strengths and weaknesses – Librarians wishing to survive the space hulk will need to equip themselves accordingly. 

Librarians are also able to select the Psychic powers they wish to use in battle. Up to three powers may be equipped at once, with each ability activated at the press of a hotkey, and limited by a cooldown. Unlike weaponry, Psychic powers are unlocked through a skill tree. By default, you’ll start with the Shockwave and Chain Lightning powers, with more becoming available as you progress. From forcing back enemies in a 360-degree arc, to purifying Xenos with holy fire, Librarians can adapt to any combat situation!  

[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/45/1478787670-vlcsnap-2015-02-20-12h42m20s46.png[/img]

[b]The Genestealers [/b]

Acting as the spearhead for a Hive Fleet, the Genestealers are a species of Tyranid armed with ferocious speed, cunning intellect and large claws that can slash through even the strongest armor. Space Hulk: Deathwing sees you and your squad facing swarms of these Genestealers – but to overcome the Xenos tide, you’ll first need to understand how these devastating foes fight in battle. 

The primary strength of the Genestealers lies in their numbers. A lone Genestealer is no match for the firepower of a Terminator squad. However, if a Xenos swarm is able to fully surround your squad, their powerful claws can make short work of you. 

The Genestealers in Space Hulk: Deathwing can be unpredictable, and will do everything they can do overwhelm you. If a lone Genestealer spots you in the distance, it may run away in order to join a larger ambush later on. Conversely, a large group may split in to two smaller groups, before attacking from all sides. 

When the Genestealers are up-close and personal, it’s a good idea to engage them in melee combat. They may have those claws, but your squad has the finest Force Swords, Lightning Claws and Thunder Hammers in the universe! 

As well as cutting down the Xenos with powerful blows, players can parry their attacks – particularly important when dealing with the larger Genestealer variants. Be warned though, as parrying will not protect your back and sides! 

Positioning is of vital importance in Space Hulk: Deathwing. Forcing Genestealers into a chokepoint is the most efficient way of gunning them down in great numbers under a hail of Storm Bolter fire, or dishing out heavy area-of-effect damage from your psychic powers. Of course, you won’t always be fighting them in tight corridors, and wide open areas are often a convenient place for an unexpected Genestealer ambush… 

[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/45/1478787688-vlcsnap-2015-02-20-12h50m52s10.png[/img]

[b]Surviving Olethros [/b]

You and your squad will journey deep into the heart of Olethros, an immense Space Hulk that’s recently emerged from the warp into Imperial space. The Olethros is made up of derelict spaceships, vast asteroids and debris – this mix of different environments means you’ll need to adapt your combat style to take on the Genestealer horde.  

Thankfully, you have a few tactical advantages available. Your auspex scanner, visible in the bottom-right corner of your HUD, is constantly scanning the local area. This gives feedback on the direction of incoming threats, letting you position your squad accordingly. Unfortunately, you won’t be given any idea on the exact numbers or types of enemy you’ll be encountering! 

Much like the tabletop game from which Space Hulk: Deathwing takes its name, the entrances to rooms and corridors are very important. To help stem the tide of Genestealers, you may decide to seal a door shut, slowing down the swarm as the Xenos navigate to an alternate route. 

Occasionally, you’ll come across doors that are already sealed shut. When this happens, you’re presented with an interesting choice: find a different (and slower) path to your objective, or smash down the door, giving the Genestealers another entrance to surround you from. 

Stay tuned for future dev blogs, where we’ll go into more detail about online co-op, more combat details and other exciting features you can expect when Space Hulk: Deathwing releases later this month! 

Pre-order on Steam now and you’ll get access to the pre-order Beta, 15% off, and one in-game weapon – the Lost Mace of Corswain.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/298900

[b]All glory to the Emperor! 

Streum On Studio and Focus Home Interactive[/b]
